structured-task-scope-concept.title: Structured concurrency with StructuredTaskScope
structured-task-scope-concept.short: Treat related subtasks as one unit
structured-task-scope-concept.summary: StructuredTaskScope groups related concurrent subtasks so their lifetime and failure handling follow the surrounding task.
structured-task-scope-concept.why: A lexical scope makes concurrent work easier to cancel, join, and reason about as a unit.
structured-task-scope-concept.tips: This API is preview in Java 25; enable preview features and expect source changes across preview releases.

stream-gatherer-concept.title: Stream Gatherers
stream-gatherer-concept.summary: Gatherers extend streams with stateful intermediate transformations such as fixed windows and custom incremental processing.
stream-gatherer-concept.why: They cover transformations that are awkward to express with map, filter, and reduce alone.
stream-gatherer-concept.tips: Prefer built-in gatherers when they match the operation, and keep custom gatherer state well-defined.

map-copy-of-snapshot.title: Create an unmodifiable map snapshot
map-copy-of-snapshot.summary: Map.copyOf creates an unmodifiable map containing the current mappings of another map.
map-copy-of-snapshot.why: It is a concise way to publish map data without exposing ordinary mutation operations.
map-copy-of-snapshot.tips: Null keys and values are rejected, and do not assume a particular iteration order unless the API guarantees it.

string-indent-transform.title: Indent and transform strings
string-indent-transform.summary: String.indent adjusts line indentation while String.transform passes a string through a chosen transformation function.
string-indent-transform.why: These APIs make common text pipelines explicit without temporary helper variables.
string-indent-transform.tips: Remember that indent normalizes line terminators and appends a line terminator for each resulting line.

unchecked-io-exception-stream.title: UncheckedIOException in stream pipelines
unchecked-io-exception-stream.summary: UncheckedIOException carries an IOException through APIs such as stream callbacks that cannot conveniently declare checked exceptions.
unchecked-io-exception-stream.why: Wrapping preserves the original I/O cause while satisfying a functional interface that does not declare IOException.
unchecked-io-exception-stream.tips: Catch it at a boundary that can report or recover from the underlying I/O failure, and inspect getCause().

wrong-thread-exception.title: WrongThreadException
wrong-thread-exception.short: Use thread-confined operations from the owning thread
wrong-thread-exception.summary: WrongThreadException reports that an operation was invoked from a thread other than the one required by a thread-confined resource.
wrong-thread-exception.why: Some APIs enforce ownership rules so mutable state is accessed only from the designated thread.
wrong-thread-exception.tips: Follow the ownership contract of the API rather than catching the exception and retrying from arbitrary threads.

sealed-permits-invalid-subclass-error.title: Invalid permitted subclass of a sealed type
sealed-permits-invalid-subclass-error.short: Make permitted classes direct valid subtypes
sealed-permits-invalid-subclass-error.summary: A class named in a sealed type's permits clause must directly extend or implement that sealed type and satisfy sealed hierarchy rules.
sealed-permits-invalid-subclass-error.why: The compiler enforces the closed set of direct subclasses promised by a sealed declaration.
sealed-permits-invalid-subclass-error.tips: Declare each direct permitted subtype as final, sealed, or non-sealed as required.

multi-catch-related-types-error.title: Related alternatives in multi-catch
multi-catch-related-types-error.short: Do not combine subtype and supertype alternatives
multi-catch-related-types-error.summary: A multi-catch cannot list alternatives where one exception type is a subtype of another alternative.
multi-catch-related-types-error.why: The broader exception already catches every instance of its subtype, making the narrower alternative redundant.
multi-catch-related-types-error.tips: Keep only the common supertype or split catches when behavior genuinely differs.

fallthrough-lint-switch-warning.title: Switch fall-through lint warning
fallthrough-lint-switch-warning.summary: The fallthrough lint warning highlights statement switch cases that continue into the next case without an obvious terminating statement.
fallthrough-lint-switch-warning.why: A missing break can silently execute code belonging to another case.
fallthrough-lint-switch-warning.tips: Use arrow-style switch rules when fall-through is not intended, or document intentional fall-through clearly.

parallel-stream-order-side-effects.title: Side effects in parallel stream traversal
parallel-stream-order-side-effects.short: Avoid order-dependent mutation in parallel pipelines
parallel-stream-order-side-effects.summary: Mutating shared result state from parallel stream callbacks can race or produce order-dependent behavior.
parallel-stream-order-side-effects.why: Parallel callbacks may execute concurrently and in an order different from encounter order.
parallel-stream-order-side-effects.tips: Express result construction with stream operations and collectors instead of mutating shared containers from forEach.
